content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. Specifically: 

- Regarding the clause allowing termination based on subjective judgment: The Client can terminate the contract immediately based on its own subjective judgment that your ability to perform has been adversely affected by any event, creating a high risk of abrupt cancellation without fair cause. I propose we update this so that: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice in the event of a material breach by the other party that remains uncured.

- Regarding the clause addressing compensation upon termination: If the contract is terminated, you are explicitly denied any compensation or indemnification, meaning you may not get paid for work already completed or expenses incurred. I propose we update this so that: Upon termination by the Client for convenience, the Client shall pay the Contractor for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

Thank you for your time and understanding. I look forward to moving forward once these details are settled. Best regards.
